summary: 최신 두 연구 종합은 통계적으로 타당한 비교 방향과 주장 한계를 유지한다. 현재 C0 P0를 효능 연구로 오인할 근거는 없다. 아래 4개는 이미 인정된 미완성 명세를 P1/P2에서 구체화해야 하는 사항이며, 기존 P0 준비를 재개방하거나 새 일반 gate를 요구하는 결함 목록이 아니다.
severity_scope: HIGH/MEDIUM describe consequences if the future comparison proceeds or claims confirmation without the stated specification; no finding is an observed P0 efficacy defect.

findings.phase: Before P1 B/C/G assignment; no change requested to frozen C0 P0
findings.title: 공통 권리와 C/G 의무의 원칙은 맞지만 실제 처치·자원 경계가 아직 동결되지 않았다.

evidence.detail: End-to-end graph cost and equal hard ceilings are the intended comparison.
All future resource-envelope values remain null.
Operational arm table explicitly is not executable; prompt/tool/config, capsule byte ceilings and activation receipts remain null.
Common measurement boundaries and C/G research obligations must have distinct, equally enforced loci.
Latest synthesis retains matched rights, obligations, scheduler and recovery; no frozen arm implementation is supplied.
Current C0 protocol explicitly has between-message/sampled token enforcement, not a hard in-flight cap.

findings.why_it_matters: G−C can identify the assigned graph-control package, but only once that package and its common substrate are defined. Differences in usable evidence delivery, critic/recovery opportunities, gate strength or uncharged graph work could otherwise become unintended treatment components. Equal consumption is not required; unequal certified limits or unreported overflow cannot support the stated fixed-resource interpretation.
findings.minimum_correction: In the next P1 task contract, bind B/C/G prompt/tool/controller/capsule bytes, exact compulsory obligation predicates and gate locations, equivalent non-graph computation rights, common scheduler/opportunity ceilings, and all-descendant extraction/recovery/final-assessment costs. Declare actual budget enforcement and overshoot/unknown-cost rules. Preserve the current P0 monitored-cap scope instead of retroactively calling it hard enforcement.
findings.inexpensive_falsification_check: Before model work, have a reviewer walk the same permitted source revision, stale-scope case and near-budget request through the three declared arm tables. Only declared treatment differences should change admissibility or delivered information. Account for a graph build and a recovery attempt in the same ledger; any free work, undeclared tool right, unequal common rejection or missing overflow rule refutes the matched implementation claim.
findings.uncertainty: No B/C/G implementation or scientific trace was run or audited. This is an acknowledged unfilled specification, not evidence that a completed comparison is confounded.

findings.domain: estimand, final selection and missing outcomes
findings.phase: Metric and outcome table before P1; final confirmation analysis before P2
findings.title: 단일 hidden artifact primary는 타당하지만 전 배정 분모의 수치 결과와 결측 분석은 과제별로 아직 정의되지 않았다.

evidence.detail: Metric, aggregation, invalid handling and selection rule are null while single frozen final artifact is specified.
All-assigned census and non-fabrication are required, but exact metric-specific missingness rule is explicitly unset.
Agent selection, no-lock/fallback and separate scorer/artifact/missing outcome axes are required, not fully populated.
Latest synthesis leaves task metric/normalization and predeclared missingness to the future task protocol.
C0 already binds controller historical code selection, final refit and hidden MAE after prediction lock; it is not an archive-best policy.

findings.why_it_matters: Keeping all assignments in a ledger is necessary but does not itself define an all-assigned numerical estimand. No lock/no usable artifact, artifact-dependent scorer crash and a lost score for an otherwise valid artifact have different outcome meanings. Complete-case paired differences can select on treatment-dependent success. Unbounded error metrics also have no finite worst-case missing-score bound without an explicit support or sensitivity assumption.
findings.minimum_correction: Bind one task-specific table covering eligible artifact and immutable lock/deadline, incomplete/no lock and any permitted baseline fallback, final refit and scorer timeout/retry, valid poor score, protocol violation, and unobserved score. Freeze score direction, cross-task normalization/weights and aggregation. For unobserved efficacy specify justified bounds/sensitivity assumptions or a non-identifiable result; a separately defined operational utility floor must not be substituted for hidden efficacy. Retain every assignment and all failure/scoring costs.
findings.inexpensive_falsification_check: On paper, apply the analysis to one valid poor score, one no-lock assignment, one locked artifact whose scorer crashes, and one lost scorer receipt. Check that the denominator never silently shrinks, no unknown value becomes zero, and missingness assumptions cannot be changed to reverse the declared conclusion. Also verify that an agent may rationally select a non-best-dev candidate without the evaluator replacing its choice.
findings.uncertainty: No actual missing P0 scientific outcome exists: P0 never started. The future metric, family composition and missingness frequency are unknown; no numeric penalty or attrition rate is proposed.

findings.phase: Ancestry/eligibility/sampling commitment before development; actual confirmation freeze before P2 reveal
findings.title: P0 family의 개발 전용 처리는 해결됐지만 향후 독립 programme의 표집·ancestry 경계는 아직 비어 있다.

evidence.detail: P0 House Price family is explicitly development-only even without a score.
Natural versus event-inclusive target population remains unselected.
Family lists and nested repeats are null; correct paired ancestry-unit analysis is required.
Sealing requires eligibility/ancestry/sampling and disclosure of exposure; hashes do not establish concealment.
Task/source-data/generator ancestry and shared-framework exception must be specified; rename/re-split does not create a new family.
Latest decision still defers confirmation task sample to a task-bound protocol.

findings.why_it_matters: An independent sample size cannot be read from the count of task names, contexts or seeds. Related source-data/generator tasks can make the uncertainty too small and allow development decisions to transfer into nominal confirmation. Choosing an event schedule from observed G advantage changes the target population. Shared public exposure may modify a real randomized policy effect; it is not automatically internal confounding, but it limits an unseen-task claim.
findings.minimum_correction: Create the actual future task register with source-data/generator family IDs, shared-library exception, prior human/model exposure where knowable, development membership and the precommitted confirmation sampling procedure. Define the natural/event-inclusive population and any exogenous event release/nonreach policy. Use paired blocks and inference at the actual independent ancestry/assignment unit with nested starts, and state the reachable generalization scope. Preserve House Price exclusion; do not repeat its data preparation.
findings.inexpensive_falsification_check: Blindly relabel a P0-derived re-split and two tasks sharing a data generator in a small metadata-only example. Apply the proposed family rule: renaming must not increase independent n or admit P0 ancestry to confirmation. Check that a programme which never reaches a scheduled event remains in its assigned denominator.
findings.uncertainty: The packet contains no selected future family registry, so actual leakage, between-programme variation and feasible independent sample size were not assessed. No numerical sample-size floor is justified.

findings.domain: development selection, MUE and confirmation precision
findings.phase: Selection procedure and MUE commitment before P1 labelled outcomes; one contrast and analysis before P2
findings.title: 개발 선택과 확인을 분리하는 원칙은 있으나 선택 함수·MUE·정밀도·최종 판정표가 아직 실행 가능한 규칙이 아니다.

evidence.detail: MUE, power/precision and repeats remain null; development variance must retain estimation uncertainty.
P1 selects candidates/comparator; P2 has one contrast; numeric decision rules and complete mutually exclusive regions remain unset.
MUE/value derivation must be committed before P1 labelled contrast generation or unblinding.
Development selection procedure precedes development outcomes; exact contrast follows P1 and precedes P2 outcomes.
Latest synthesis preserves primary outcome, nested units, MUE timing and no equivalence from nonsignificance.
Valid null/negative and explicitly uncertain closure are allowed; invalid-only results are feasibility, not efficacy.

findings.why_it_matters: A promise to choose the strongest credible comparator is not yet a reproducible selection rule when development data are noisy. If admissibility, ties, cost tradeoffs, MUE or confirmation size are chosen from favourable labelled effects, later interpretation can be tuned to the selected winner. A positive estimate or interval above zero alone need not establish practically useful benefit, and an imprecise null cannot establish equivalence.
findings.minimum_correction: For P1, record a task-value MUE or outcome-independent derivation/owner and exposure timestamp before labelled contrasts; freeze the candidate/comparator selection procedure including feasibility criteria, ties and cost treatment. Use development-only variance/attrition/cost with uncertainty to choose a feasible confirmation precision target and nested-repeat allocation. After P1, freeze exactly one contrast and a complete nonoverlapping efficacy/uncertainty/cost/missingness decision table before P2 reveal. No new P0 efficacy threshold or literature-derived sample number is needed.
findings.inexpensive_falsification_check: Hand-evaluate the proposed selection and decision rules for a tie, a cheaper but slightly worse candidate, a positive-small interval, an interval spanning the MUE, a harmful interval, a wide null and an unidentifiable missingness range. Each must receive exactly one declared disposition; relabelling arms must not alter tie handling or the MUE.
findings.uncertainty: There are no development scores or variance estimates in this packet. Precision and sample size cannot be certified now; the finding concerns missing task-bound rules, not observed optional stopping or biased selection.
